decisionsTitle: The difficulty's number is the level of fifteen, the dots are the step
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-09-29 14:10**, of two tooltips side by side, «Mediu 2 — nivelul 5 din 15» and «Ușor 2 — nivelul 2 din 15»: «ceva ciudat cu nivelurile, nu are cum și una grea și una ușoară să fie nivelul 2» … «vreau un scale mai clar» … «adică ușor: 1,2,3, mediu 4,5,6 și tot așa, în ordine». And at 14:18, of the tooltip: it must explain all the levels, not only the current band's — «Mediu — nivelul 5 din 15 · ușor 1–3 · mediu 4–6 · greuț 7–9 · greu 10–12 · foarte greu 13–15».

**Decision — the number is the level, the dots are the step.** The scale does not change (§526): five bands of three, one `events.difficulty_level` column 1–15, level = (band − 1) × 3 + step. Only the words change, everywhere the difficulty is said, and they come from one domain function, `difficultyWords(level, t)` in `events/domain/difficulty.ts`, which every public surface and every message reads:

- the pill (the listing card, the event page, the backoffice list — `buildRoutePills`, §388): the band alone, «Mediu» / «Medium», beside the gauge — never «Mediu 2», and, since the owner's word at 19:08 (below), not «Mediu 5» either. The editor's closed line, which draws no gauge, says the band and the level, «Mediu 5», from the backoffice catalogue's own `editor.difficultySummary` with the band word the editor's select shows;
- where no gauge is drawn (the emails' facts block, §392; the calendar entry and the `.ics`, §107): «Mediu, nivelul 5 din 15» / «Medium, level 5 of 15». «Treapta 2 din 3» is gone from both catalogues;
- the pill's tooltip, two lines: «Mediu — nivelul 5 din 15», then the whole ladder, «ușor 1–3 · mediu 4–6 · greuț 7–9 · greu 10–12 · foarte greu 13–15» (`difficultyLadder`, every range from `difficultyBandLevels`, never typed). `GlyphChip`'s tooltip keeps a newline as a line (§257);
- a screen reader hears the shorter form once, as the chip's `srLabel` (§528): «Dificultate: mediu — nivelul 5 din 15 (mediu: 4–6)» — the level and its own band's range. The whole ladder in the name of every card would be read out once per card down a listing, so it stays in the tooltip, the editor's help and «Ghid».

The gauge keeps its band segments and its step dots (§526): the dots still show where inside its band the level stands.

**The owner, 2026-09-29 19:08**, of the pill reading «Mediu 5» beside its gauge: «don't put "Mediu 2" and "Ușor 2" on the pill, the sub indicator is enough». **The pill says the band alone** — «Ușor», «Mediu», «Greuț», «Greu», «Foarte greu» / «Easy» … «Very hard» — because the gauge beside it already draws the step in its dots and the tooltip says the level: a number beside them said it a third time. `difficultyWords(level, t).short` is `Event.difficultyValues.<band>`, and `Event.difficultyLevelShort` is gone from both catalogues. Nothing else moves: the tooltip («Mediu — nivelul 5 din 15» and the ladder), the screen reader's `srLabel` («Dificultate: mediu — nivelul 5 din 15 (mediu: 4–6)»), the words where no gauge is drawn (the emails, the calendar, the `.ics`: «Mediu, nivelul 5 din 15»), the editor's closed line («Mediu 5»), the filter's «Mediu (4–6)». «Ghid» says it: on the site the pill shows the band alone and the gauge's dots show the level within the band.

**The editor (amending §526 and §537).** «Treapta» becomes «Nivelul» / «Level». Its three segments show the chosen band's own three levels — Mediu → 4 · 5 · 6, Ușor → 1 · 2 · 3 — and follow the band select as it changes; with no band chosen they show their dots and a dash. Each segment is named «Nivelul 5 din 15» for a screen reader. What posts is still the step 1 · 2 · 3, so with the band it writes the same level column: no migration. The line under the toggle says the rule in one sentence, every number from the domain: «Nivelul e de la 1 (ușor) la 15 (foarte greu): fiecare categorie are trei niveluri — ușor 1–3, mediu 4–6, greuț 7–9, greu 10–12, foarte greu 13–15.» — «categorie», not «bandă», because it is the word the editor and «Ghid» already use for a band. The «?» keeps the owner's examples in level numbers: «mediu 4: alergarea de pe Tâmpa», «greuț 7–9: de la semimaraton în sus». §537's one centred axis is unchanged.

**The filter (§413)** still ticks a whole band; its boxes and its active chips add the range, «Mediu (4–6)», and a box's hover title stays «Mediu: nivelurile 4–6 din 15» (§528). **«Ghid»** → «Scara de dificultate a clubului» says the same ladder and its examples in level numbers: «Mediu 5», and «Greu» ticking all three of its levels, 10–12 (the guide-words test refuses a parenthesised label inside «…»). Its last two steps say what the pill says on a tap — the level, «Mediu — nivelul 5 din 15», and under it the whole ladder — two sentences, so each stays within 200 characters.

**Refused:** renumbering the steps or the column — the level already runs 1–15, only the words were wrong; the whole ladder in the screen reader's name of every listing card.
changelogLine: - **The difficulty's number is its level of fifteen** — ușor 1–3, mediu 4–6, greuț 7–9, greu 10–12, foarte greu 13–15, in order: «Mediu, nivelul 5 din 15» in every email and calendar entry, «Mediu 5» on the editor's closed line, never «Mediu 2»; the pill says the band alone, «Mediu», beside its gauge, whose dots show the step and whose tooltip says the level and lists the whole ladder; the editor's «Nivelul» (was «Treapta») offers the chosen band's own three levels, and the filter says «Mediu (4–6)». §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: The difficulty pill on the listing card, the event page and the backoffice list says the band alone beside its gauge — «Ușor», «Mediu», «Foarte greu» / «Easy», «Medium», «Very hard» — with no number, while the gauge's dots show the step and the tooltip the level; the editor's closed line, which draws no gauge, says the band with the level of fifteen — «Mediu 5» — never the step inside the band (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The difficulty pill's tooltip says the level, then the whole scale with every band's three levels in order — «Mediu — nivelul 5 din 15» / «ușor 1–3 · mediu 4–6 · greuț 7–9 · greu 10–12 · foarte greu 13–15» — every range from the domain, in both languages, each line 200 characters or fewer; a screen reader hears «Dificultate: mediu — nivelul 5 din 15 (mediu: 4–6)» once, as the chip's name (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

An email's facts block, a calendar entry and the .ics say the difficulty as «Mediu, nivelul 5 din 15» / «Medium, level 5 of 15», and neither catalogue says «treapta N din 3» (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
The listing's difficulty filter still ticks a whole band, and its boxes and active chips name the band with its range — «Mediu (4–6)» / «Medium (4–6)» (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The event editor's second difficulty control is «Nivelul» / «Level»: its three segments show the chosen band's own levels of fifteen (Mediu → 4 · 5 · 6, Ușor → 1 · 2 · 3), follow the band select as it changes, show a dash while no band is chosen and still post the step 1–3; the line under it says «Nivelul e de la 1 (ușor) la 15 (foarte greu): fiecare categorie are trei niveluri — ușor 1–3, mediu 4–6, greuț 7–9, greu 10–12, foarte greu 13–15.», every number from the domain (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the difficulty's number is the level of fifteen, the dots are the step
